SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_master_id) AS distinct_ids_all,
  COUNTIF(rn = 1) AS rn1_rows,
  COUNTIF(is_deleted) AS deleted_rows,
  COUNTIF(is_deleted IS NULL) AS deleted_null,
  COUNTIF(customer_master_id IS NULL) AS null_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(rn = 1 AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE, customer_master_id, NULL)) AS active_customers
FROM `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.customers_master`
